locations.title: The Tyrant
locations.description:
**Set:** Feasting Baron's Pack  
**Type:** Boots  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 1 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) Increases the duration of your abilities that cause loss of control by 30%.
- (4 items) Increases damage done from all sources by 15% to enemies suffering under your loss of control effects.
- (6 items) Unleash a nova of ice each time you defeat an enemy afflicted by your loss of control effects, dealing 2,318 damage to nearby enemies and Freezing them for 4 seconds. Cannot occur more often than once every 40 seconds.

locations.title: Bloody Hand
locations.description:
**Set:** Grace of the Flagellant  
**Type:** Gloves  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 2 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) All continual damage, Channeled damage, and persistent ground damage increased by 15%.
- (4 items) Each time you damage an individual enemy 5 times, you will do 869 additional damage to that enemy.
- (6 items) Each time you deal damage, you have a 4% chance to unleash a lightning strike, dealing 5,217 damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 1 seconds. Cannot occur more often than once every 40 seconds.

locations.title: Issatar Undone
locations.description:
**Set:** Issatar Imbued  
**Type:** Ring  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 4 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) Each time you defeat an enemy, you gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
- (4 items) Damage dealt increased by 2.5% for every 5% increase in your Movement Speed, up to a maximum damage increase of 25%.
- (6 items) Each time you defeat an enemy, you have a 10% chance to gain an orbiting soul orb for 10 seconds, which deals 577 damage when it passes through an enemy. Cannot gain a soul orb more often than once every 40 seconds.

locations.title: Mountebank's Flourish
locations.description:
**Set:** Untouchable Mountebank  
**Type:** Amulet  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 2 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) Each time you take damage, you have a 20% chance to gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 13% of your maximum Life. Cannot occur more often than once every 9 seconds.
- (4 items) Shield's damage absorption increased to 33% of your maximum Life, and you can move unhindered through enemies while this shield is active.
- (6 items) Your shield has a 25% chance when it expires to explode for 40% of your maximum Life in damage to all nearby enemies.

locations.title: Exemplar's Urge
locations.description:
**Set:** Vithu's Urges  
**Type:** Belt  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 1 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) Increases the duration of all beneficial effects on you or your party members by 30%.
- (4 items) Increases the target's Attack Speed by 30% for 3 seconds each time you use a skill to grant a beneficial effect to yourself or a party member.
- (6 items) Each time you use a skill to buff yourself or a party member, creates an area of apotheosis for 12 seconds that grants 12% Life Drain to yourself and any party members within the area. Cannot occur more often than once every 40 seconds.

locations.title: Braided Serpent of Shal'baas
locations.description:
**Set:** War Rags of Shal'baas  
**Type:** Ring  
**Acquired from:** [Cavern of Echoes](#loc=191107) on Hell 4 difficulty  
**Set Bonus:**
- (2 items) Primary Attack damage increased by 15%.
- (4 items) Your Primary Attacks gradually increase your Attack Speed, up to a maximum of 25%.
- (6 items) Your Primary Attacks have a 5% chance to increase your Attack Speed for 12 seconds, cannot occur more than once every 40 seconds.
